f.title: Take all technical and administrative measures for an appropriate level of security of personal data
f.statement: The data controller must take all necessary technical and administrative measures to ensure an appropriate level of security in order to prevent unlawful processing of personal data, prevent unlawful access to personal data and ensure the safekeeping of personal data (KVKK Art. 12(1), recalled by the decision).
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety system configuration

rows.quote:
12 nci maddesinin (1) numaralı fıkrasında veri sorumlusunun;
 Kişisel verilerin hukuka aykırı olarak işlenmesini önlemek,
 Kişisel verilere hukuka aykırı olarak erişilmesini önlemek,

rows.review_note: Review: legal duty recalled from KVKK Art. 12(1) ('zorunda olduğu' = is obliged); kept although the decision only recites it, because security is the breach-prevention duty the decision builds on. rows.quote_en: [it is provided] in paragraph (1) of Article 12 that the data controller is obliged to take all necessary technical and administrative measures to ensure the appropriate level of security for the purposes of: preventing the unlawful processing of personal data, preventing unlawful access to personal data, ensuring the safekeeping of personal data,

f.title: Notify the Board of a personal data breach without delay and at the latest within 72 hours of learning of it
f.statement: Where personal data processed are obtained by others by unlawful means, the data controller must notify the Personal Data Protection Board without delay and at the latest within 72 hours from the date it learned of the breach; the Board interprets 'as soon as possible' in KVKK Art. 12(5) as 72 hours.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.deadline: Without delay and at the latest within 72 hours of learning of the breach
rows.quote: “en kısa sürede” ifadesinin 72 saat olarak yorumlanmasına ve bu kapsamda veri sorumlusunun bu durumu öğrendiği tarihten itibaren gecikmeksizin ve en geç 72 saat içinde Kurula bildirmesine,
data_elements: date the controller learned of the breach
rows.review_note: Review: Board decision ('... bildirmesine ... karar verilmiştir' = it has been decided that the controller shall notify) binding; Mandatory. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: clock start verbatim; 72 hours.
rows.quote_en: that the expression 'as soon as possible' be interpreted as 72 hours and, in this context, that the data controller notify the Board without delay and at the latest within 72 hours from the date it learned of the situation,

deadline_rule.clock_start: veri sorumlusunun bu durumu öğrendiği tarihten itibaren

f.title: Notify affected persons of the breach within the shortest reasonable time, directly or, if unreachable, e.g. on the controller's website
f.statement: After identifying the persons affected by the breach, the data controller must notify them within the shortest reasonable time: directly if their contact address can be reached, otherwise by appropriate methods such as publication on the controller's own website.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.deadline: Within the shortest reasonable time after identifying the affected persons
rows.quote: veri sorumlusunca söz konusu veri ihlalinden etkilenen kişilerin belirlenmesini müteakip ilgili kişilere de makul olan en kısa süre içerisinde, ilgili kişinin iletişim adresine ulaşılabiliyorsa doğrudan, ulaşılamıyorsa veri sorumlusunun kendi web sitesi üzerinden yayımlanması gibi uygun yöntemlerle bildirim yapılmasına,
rows.review_note: Review: binding Board decision; no numeric deadline, so no deadline_rule. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: that, following the identification by the data controller of the persons affected by the data breach, notification also be made to the data subjects within the shortest reasonable time, directly if the data subject's contact address can be reached, and if not, by appropriate methods such as publication on the data controller's own website,

f.title: Explain to the Board the reasons for any delay when the breach cannot be notified within 72 hours for a justified reason
f.statement: If the data controller cannot notify the Board within 72 hours for a justified reason, it must explain the reasons for the delay to the Board together with the notification.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Veri sorumlusu tarafından Kurula haklı bir gerekçe ile 72 saat içinde bildirim yapılamaması halinde, yapılacak bildirimle birlikte gecikmenin nedenlerinin de Kurula açıklanmasına,
rows.review_note: Review: binding Board decision; Mandatory. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: that, where the data controller is unable, with a justified reason, to notify the Board within 72 hours, the reasons for the delay also be explained to the Board together with the notification to be made,

f.title: Use the Board's Personal Data Breach Notification Form
f.statement: Notifications of personal data breaches to the Board must be made using the 'Personal Data Breach Notification Form' published with the decision. The form is to be completed only by the data controller.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.

f.title: Provide breach information in phases, without delay, where it cannot all be provided at once
f.statement: Where the information required in the notification form cannot be provided at the same time, the data controller must provide it in phases without undue delay.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Formda yer alan bilgilerin aynı anda sağlanmasının mümkün olmadığı hallerde, bu bilgilerin gecikmeye mahal verilmeksizin aşamalı olarak sağlanmasına,
rows.review_note: Review: binding Board decision. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: that, in cases where it is not possible to provide the information in the form at the same time, this information be provided in stages without giving rise to delay,

f.title: Record each data breach, its effects and the measures taken, and keep the record available for Board review
f.statement: The data controller must record information on data breaches, their effects and the measures taken, and keep these records ready for review by the Board.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: Veri sorumlusu tarafından veri ihlallerine ilişkin bilgilerin, etkilerinin ve alınan önlemlerin kayıt altına alınması ve Kurulun incelemesine hazır halde bulundurulmasına,
rows.review_note: Review: binding Board decision; no retention period stated. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: that information on data breaches, their effects and the measures taken be recorded by the data controller and kept ready for the Board's examination,

f.title: Processor must notify the data controller of a data breach without any delay
f.statement: Where personal data held by a data processor are obtained by others by unlawful means, the data processor must notify the data controller without any delay.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote: Veri işleyen nezdinde bulunan kişisel verilerin kanuni olmayan yollarla başkaları tarafından elde edilmesi halinde, veri işleyenin bu konuda herhangi bir gecikmeye yer vermeksizin veri sorumlusuna bildirimde bulunmasına,
rows.review_note: Review: binding Board decision; in a pharma context the controller should flow this down into PV service agreements. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: that, where personal data held by the data processor are obtained by others by unlawful means, the data processor notify the data controller without any delay,

f.title: Controller established abroad must notify the Board of breaches affecting persons in Türkiye using its products or services there
f.statement: Where a data breach occurs at a data controller established abroad, and the breach affects data subjects resident in Türkiye who use the products and services offered in Türkiye, that data controller must also notify the Board under the same principles (72 hours, form, reasons for delay).
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Data controller established outside Türkiye (e.g. global MAH or safety-database owner)
rows.quote: Veri ihlalinin yurtdışında yerleşik veri sorumlusu nezdinde yaşanması halinde, bu ihlalin sonuçlarının Türkiye’de yerleşik ilgili kişileri etkilemesi ve ilgili kişilerin sunulan ürün ve hizmetlerden Türkiye’de faydalanmaları durumunda, bu veri sorumlusu tarafından da aynı esaslar çerçevesinde Kurula bildirimde bulunulmasına,
rows.review_note: Review: binding Board decision; relevant where the global safety database is held by a foreign group company. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
rows.quote_en: that, where the data breach occurs at a data controller established abroad, if the consequences of the breach affect data subjects resident in Türkiye and the data subjects benefit in Türkiye from the products and services offered, this data controller also notify the Board within the framework of the same principles,

f.title: Prepare a data breach response plan (internal reporting lines, notifications, impact assessment, responsibilities) and review it periodically
f.statement: The data controller must prepare a data breach response plan covering, among other things, to whom breaches are reported internally, the notifications to be made under the Law, the assessment of the possible consequences of a breach, and who is responsible within the organisation, and must review the plan at regular intervals.
f.applicability: Türkiye; Personal Data Protection Board (Kurul) Decision 2019/10 of 24.01.2019 on the procedures and principles of personal data breach notification (announcement published 15 February 2019), interpreting Law No. 6698 (KVKK) Art. 12(5). Applies to a pharma company as data controller (veri sorumlusu) of personal data such as ICSR, patient-support or trial safety data.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA; Safety governance

rows.deadline: Review at regular intervals (no frequency stated)

rows.review_note: Review: binding Board decision; no review frequency given. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: confirmed.
